heading: Ideas turned into systems
description: Shipped tools, learning builds, and honest work in progress. Click any card to open it.

projects.name: 1Link
projects.summary: One link that holds every link you want to share, built as a modular Django service.
bullets: Architected a modular Django monorepo with 7 decoupled apps for independent scaling.
Exposed a RESTful API layer with DRF serializers, user registration, and dynamic profile URL routing.
Integrated PostgreSQL for relational storage, Redis powering the leaderboard, and Celery for async background jobs.

projects.name: TypeRush
projects.summary: A cross-platform terminal typing trainer with live WPM and accuracy across five modes.
bullets: Built a cross-platform terminal typing trainer in Rust with live WPM and accuracy tracking across 5 modes.
Added a themeable TUI with a configurable settings system and persistent session history across runs.
Developed end to end with AI-assisted coding in Claude Code, shipping CI-built binaries for Linux, macOS, and Windows.

projects.name: Portfolio v1
projects.summary: My first portfolio, a single-page React and Vite site on GitHub Pages. Retired in July 2026 when this version replaced it; the source is preserved at the v1.1.0 tag.
bullets: Built a single-page portfolio with React 19, Vite, and Tailwind CSS v4, deployed to GitHub Pages via GitHub Actions.
Kept all display content in one JSON file so text, links, and assets change without touching component code.
Added a Framer Motion preloader, scroll reveals, and a play-reel hero video.
Replaced by this site, a Next.js static export, after outgrowing the single-file content model.

projects.name: Prompt Navigator
projects.tagline: Jump to any prompt in your AI chat
projects.summary: A browser extension that lists every prompt you sent in ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, so you can jump, search, favorite, and export them.
bullets: Lists every message you sent in a conversation on ChatGPT, Claude, and Gemini, with click to scroll, live search, and match highlighting.
Adds favorites, per-prompt copy, and export to JSON, CSV, and PDF, with an auto, dark, and light theme.
Core feature is a working proof of concept in the testing phase; remaining work is more platforms and full testing before release.

projects.name: mute-ads
projects.summary: A browser extension that silences ads on Hotstar the moment they start and restores your exact volume when the content returns.
bullets: Started during an IPL season to auto-mute ads while streaming, muting on ad start and restoring the exact prior volume.
Hotstar's restrictions and dynamic page behavior made it need far more effort than it was worth, so it is currently buggy and not functional.
Kept listed as an honest initiative that did not pan out.

projects.name: URL Shortener
projects.summary: A URL shortener built to understand Django internals, system scaling, and architecture design decisions. Incomplete by design.
bullets: Built with Django and PostgreSQL to learn Django internals from the inside out.
Used as a sandbox for system scaling and architecture design decisions.
Incomplete by design, kept as a running learning and revision project.

projects.name: GitHub API Dashboard
projects.tagline: Surface a developer's most active day
projects.summary: A dashboard that consumes the GitHub API to surface a user's most active working day and commit distribution, built to learn GraphQL and Apollo.
bullets: Built to learn GraphQL, consuming external APIs through it, and Apollo GraphQL.
Features a dashboard and charts that surface a user's most active working day and commit distribution.

projects.name: ChatGPT Gmail Bot
projects.summary: A Chrome extension that connects ChatGPT to Gmail and drafts reply emails for incoming messages, built when ChatGPT first launched.
bullets: Chrome extension that integrates ChatGPT into Gmail to draft replies for incoming emails.
Built when ChatGPT first launched, to automate routine responses so they did not have to be written by hand.

projects.name: Chess Training Games
projects.summary: Interactive chess training games built to develop reaction time and pattern muscle memory, for myself and people around me.
bullets: Chess training games that improve reaction time and pattern muscle memory through interactive play.
Built for myself and for people around me.

projects.name: Hulu Clone
projects.tagline: Streaming UI built to learn Next.js
projects.summary: A Hulu-style streaming site that shows the latest movies by category, built to learn Next.js, Tailwind, clean UI composition, and external API integration.
bullets: Recreated Hulu's interface with Next.js and TypeScript, showing films organized by category.
Built to learn Next.js, Tailwind CSS, clean UI composition, and external API integration.

projects.name: 4 = 10 Solver Bot
projects.tagline: Solves any puzzle from the 4 = 10 app
projects.summary: A solver bot that finds valid operator combinations for any puzzle from the 4 = 10 app.
bullets: Solves any puzzle from the 4 = 10 app by finding operator combinations that reach the target.
Takes any numbers and a desired result and returns valid solutions.

projects.name: Twitter Tweepy API
projects.tagline: Fetch, search, and filter Twitter data
projects.summary: A Tweepy-based tool that fetches, searches, and filters Twitter data by hashtag and other criteria, with import and export for analysis. Built at a college faculty request.
bullets: Built at a college faculty request to fetch, search, and filter Twitter data by hashtag and other criteria.
Supports import and export in JSON and CSV for post performance analysis.
